g.text: Build recording in the browser; it demos well
Kill it: 21 files, browser capture is worse
Draw the line: apps record, website stores and shares
Rule: stop means watch, upload behind it
Break the rule in the Mac app; fix it
Android refuses the documented order; reorder the service
Audit permissions the build asks for; block the one I never wanted
Someone else's recording. Narrow the share rule.
Three looks at once; make one identity
Live on Mac, Android, and the web
